jobs.title: Robotics Engineer

bonus.terms: Paid directly by Synphony. Contact Christopher to confirm eligibility and payout timing.

jobs.description: Synphony’s Forward Deployed Robotics Engineer role owns robot deployments from customer scoping and data collection through learned policies, controls, integration, and reliable operation in the field.
requirements: Experience deploying learned policies on physical robots, with strong ML fundamentals.
Hands-on robotics integration: sensors, calibration, controls, and ROS or robot SDKs.
Work across imitation learning, reinforcement learning, VLA fine-tuning, and simulation-to-reality evaluation.
Customer-facing ownership of robot deployments in industrial settings.
